relationships.summary: Old friends. She thinks he is lonely, not secretive.
Fond of her, and careful never to let her near his business.
Liked the boy. Thought he talked too freely about money.
Slips her bread and soup, and worries about her come winter.
Odette feeds her and asks nothing back.
Never liked the clerk. Since the night the Merrow sailed dark, afraid of him too.
Finds him efficient and a little too tidy. She has started to wonder why.
Respects her, and is afraid of how close she is getting.
Her younger brother. She loves him, and has spent years getting him out of trouble.
Adores his sister and hates to disappoint her.
